verdict.rationale: Ghostty has its own programmatic control surface: a built-in AppleScript dictionary for scripting windows, tabs, terminals, layouts and input events, plus Apple Shortcuts (AppIntents) support. Every configuration key also works as a CLI flag. However, this is documented only for macOS, and nothing shows it reaches parity with everything the UI can do. libghostty is a developer building block for embedding, not a control API, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: evidence of full UI-to-API parity, a cross-platform (Linux/Windows) scripting or control API, in-depth reference docs for the automation surface, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the scripting capabilities.
